errors.evidence: The description states that the years on the horizontal axis (2014, 2015) have no specific order, when in fact they are arranged in chronological order.
The description identifies the color of the 'ДОО' bars as red ('червено'), but the color in the chart is more accurately described as reddish-brown or terracotta.
The description reports the value for 'ДЗПО + ДДПО' in 2015 as 9,335, but the data label on the bar in the chart shows the value is 9,333.
